decisions.reason: The thermoforming unit has had its own page for two years, which signals sustained commitment, and it fits the dental lab equipment core, so keeping this low-cost option open is justified.

The orthopedic shoe last is a recent launch into an adjacent market where its value is still uncertain, and since it uses existing digital manufacturing capability it is cheap to keep while results come in.
The post-curing unit complements the firm's 3D-printing workflow and was only just launched, so its uncertainty has not yet resolved and keeping it costs little.
